title: Recover green master provenance after unauthorized direct push
acceptance_criteria: Document autonomous recovery procedure for a direct-master-push incident
Current master state is revalidated through the single integration PR
Task reaches MERGED_VERIFIED with PR/head/merge/post-merge evidence
validation_commands: cd frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build

blocker.reason: Post-merge verification cannot complete while unrelated processes continue pushing directly to unprotected master and cancelling/replacing the merge CI run.
blocker.evidence: PR #34 exact-head CI #258 passed and merge de3a33305bae245cf2d8cf81b5e0037c20011302 landed, but post-merge CI #259 was cancelled after master advanced to direct-pushed descendants including 98b096f7e18d0e3721d340110112b962dcd73127. GitHub reports master protection disabled.
blocker.next_action: Enable the master branch protection/ruleset recorded in TASK-ADMIN-BRANCH-PROTECTION, or otherwise stop direct master writers; then rerun a normal PR recovery and require post-merge master-merge-audit success.

notes: PR #34 exact-head CI #258 passed all required jobs, including fabric tests/validator, feature preservation, KREATE/repository-data checks, frontend regression, and latest-master discipline.
Post-merge CI #259 was cancelled by newer master activity before verification could complete; current master remains a descendant of the recovery merge and retains the fabric changes.
This task is BLOCKED, not DONE. Product and other non-overlapping autonomous tasks may continue; branch protection is tracked separately as the only critical human/admin gate.
